name: modbusMaster.py
func:
from pymodbus.client.sync import ModbusSerialClient
import time
import serial
import json

dataS = []
opArray = []

parameter =json.loads(msg['payload'])
comm = msg['comm']

client = ModbusSerialClient(method = 'rtu', port = comm[0], baudrate = comm[1], parity = comm[2], stopbits = comm[3],timeout=5)

for i in range(parameter[0]):
    try:
        regs = client.read_holding_registers(parameter[i+1][1], parameter[i+1][2], unit = parameter[i+1][0])
        dataS = regs.registers if regs else None
        z = json.dumps({'id': parameter[i+1][0], 'register': parameter[i+1][1], 'data': dataS, 'status': "Connected"})
        opArray.append(z)
        dataS = []
        time.sleep(0.1)
    except:
        z = json.dumps({'id': parameter[i+1][0], 'register': parameter[i+1][1], 'data': dataS, 'status': "Disconnected"})
        opArray.append(z)
        time.sleep(0.1)

msg['payload'] = opArray
return msg

name: date selection

format:
<input type="date" id="datePart">
<input type="time" id="timePart">
<button ng-click="submitDate()">Submit</button>

<script>
(function(scope) {
  scope.$watch('msg', function(msg) {
    if (msg) {
      $("#my_" + scope.$id).html(msg.payload);
    }
  });

  scope.submitDate = function() {
    const date = document.getElementById("datePart").value;
    const time = document.getElementById("timePart").value;

    if (date && time) {
      const isoString = `${date}T${time}`;
      const dateObj = new Date(isoString);

      // Format date and time separately
      const datePart = dateObj.toLocaleDateString('en-IN', {
        day: '2-digit',
        month: 'long',
        year: 'numeric'
      });

      const timePart = dateObj.toLocaleTimeString('en-IN', {
        hour: '2-digit',
        minute: '2-digit',
        hour12: true
      });

      const finalOutput = `${datePart} IST ${timePart}`;

      const msg = {
        payload: {
          formattedDate: finalOutput
        }
      };

      scope.send(msg);
    } else {
      scope.send({ payload: "Please select both date and time." });
    }
  };
})(scope);
</script>
